patterns.name: Fan-in queue
patterns.trigger: Several producers feed one constrained resource, so waiting and capacity tell the story.
patterns.budget: Up to 5 sources and 5 queued items; group extra sources into one cohort.

patterns.name: Stage framework
patterns.trigger: Every stage answers the same set of questions, and comparing stages matters most.
primitives: one slot row per question, labelled
a visible marker for an empty slot
patterns.budget: 3 to 6 stages, at most 4 slot rows, about 20 filled cells.

patterns.name: Input to artifact
patterns.trigger: Loose input such as a chat or notes is turned into a lasting structured record.
primitives: a short excerpt of the input
the finished record with its fields
links from statements to the fields they fill
patterns.budget: At most 4 input excerpts, 6 record fields and 3 provenance links.

patterns.name: Paired traces
patterns.trigger: Two similar requests end differently and the reader must find where they split.
primitives: a worded status per rule on each side
the first point of divergence, marked
patterns.budget: Two traces, 3 to 6 rules, one marked divergence.

patterns.name: Paved road
patterns.trigger: A supported route crosses trust boundaries, and some routes must be shown as blocked.
primitives: allowed routes with a text label
blocked routes that end at the zone edge
patterns.budget: Up to 3 zones, 8 components and 2 blocked routes.

patterns.name: Control catalogue
patterns.trigger: Controls only make sense grouped by the surface that enforces them.
patterns.budget: 3 to 5 surfaces, about 24 controls in all.

patterns.name: Compensating layers
patterns.trigger: Each defence catches some of what the previous one missed, and some risk survives.
primitives: layers in order, each with what it stops
the residual risk at the end, stated in words
patterns.budget: 3 to 5 layers following one risk thread.

patterns.name: Block decomposition
patterns.trigger: A system breaks into parts that each carry a stable id someone can cite.
primitives: detail kept in data, not on the canvas
patterns.budget: Root plus 3 levels, about 9 visible blocks; split by subsystem beyond that.

patterns.name: Lifecycle
patterns.trigger: One subject moves through phases, and its waits, retries and endings carry weight.
primitives: a separate band for waiting and recovery
a separate band for end states
patterns.budget: 4 or 5 main phases, at most 9 states and 10 transitions.

types.name: Architecture
types.bestFor: Components, the boundaries around them and the connections that cross those lines.

notThis.when: the point is what changed between two versions
machines, zones and replicas matter more than logical parts

types.budget: About 9 components in at most 3 zones.

closest.caveat: Architecture is not built yet (ng); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Architecture delta
types.bestFor: Before and after views of one system, with additions, removals and moves called out.

notThis.when: only one state of the system matters

types.budget: One system in two states, with a change ledger of up to 8 rows.
types.basis: map suite, two layouts sharing ids

closest.caveat: Architecture delta is not built yet (ng); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: IT current state
types.bestFor: An inventory of the systems in place today, grouped by department or phase.

notThis.when: the connections between systems are the message

closest.caveat: IT current state is not built yet (ng); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Flowchart
types.bestFor: Branching decisions and algorithms where steps lead to yes or no choices.

notThis.when: several actors exchange messages over time
one subject moves between named states
owners and handoffs matter more than the logic

types.basis: NetworkGraph layered layout plus node shapes

closest.caveat: Flowchart is not built yet (ng); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Sequence
types.bestFor: Messages passed between actors in order, such as a request and its response.

notThis.when: there is one subject and its state is what changes
the order of decisions matters, not who sends what

closest.caveat: Sequence is not built yet (new); Timeline (Timeline) is the closest available type.

types.name: State machine
types.bestFor: The states one subject can be in and the events that move it between them.

notThis.when: actors trade messages
the steps are decisions, not states

closest.caveat: State machine is not built yet (ng); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Entity relationship
types.bestFor: Entities, their attributes and how many of one relate to another.

notThis.when: physical tables, keys and column types are the point
classes carry methods and inheritance

types.name: Timeline
types.bestFor: Dated events placed along one time axis.

notThis.when: tasks span date ranges
a measure changes continuously over time

types.name: Swimlane
types.bestFor: Work passing between owners, one lane per owner, with each handoff drawn.

notThis.when: rows are questions asked at every stage rather than owners
there is only one owner

closest.caveat: Swimlane is not built yet (new); Timeline (Timeline) is the closest available type.

types.name: Quadrant
types.bestFor: Items placed on two judged axes and read by the corner they land in.

notThis.when: both axes are measured and the spread matters

types.budget: About 12 items and one label per corner.

closest.caveat: Quadrant is not built yet (template); Scatter (Scatter) is the closest available type.

types.name: Radar
types.bestFor: A few items compared across the same five to eight measures.

notThis.when: more than three items are compared
the categories repeat in a cycle such as months

types.budget: 3 to 8 axes and at most 3 series.

closest.caveat: Radar is not built yet (new); Bar (BarList) is the closest available type.

types.name: Polar
types.bestFor: Values for categories that wrap around, such as hours of a day.

notThis.when: the categories have no natural cycle

closest.caveat: Polar is not built yet (new); Bar (BarList) is the closest available type.

types.name: Loop
types.bestFor: A cycle that feeds itself, such as a flywheel or a review loop.

notThis.when: the cycle has exits and end states

closest.caveat: Loop is not built yet (ng); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Nested
types.bestFor: Containment where each level sits wholly inside the one above.

notThis.when: a parent has several children
the levels are ordered defences, not containers

types.budget: Up to 5 levels in a single chain.

closest.caveat: Nested is not built yet (ng); Treemap (Treemap) is the closest available type.

types.name: Tree
types.bestFor: A hierarchy in which each child has exactly one parent.

notThis.when: a node has several parents or links form cycles
the nodes are people with roles
the size of each branch is the message

types.budget: Root plus 3 levels, about 5 children per node.

closest.caveat: Tree is not built yet (ng); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Org chart
types.bestFor: Who reports to whom, with a name and role on each card.

notThis.when: the nodes are not people or teams

closest.caveat: Org chart is not built yet (ng); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Layer stack
types.bestFor: Ordered layers, each resting on the one beneath, with what each layer holds.

notThis.when: the layers are containers drawn inside one another
it is a data platform split into quality tiers

types.budget: 4 to 6 layers with a few items each.

closest.caveat: Layer stack is not built yet (new); Bar (BarList) is the closest available type.

types.name: Exploded axonometric
types.bestFor: Illustrated 3D art that pulls a product apart into its parts.

notThis.when: the parts and how they stack are what matters
the parts form a hierarchy

types.basis: not planned: illustration with no data to compute it from

closest.caveat: Exploded axonometric is not planned; Treemap (Treemap) is the closest available type.

types.name: Axonometric plan
types.bestFor: A floor-plan illustration of a physical space.

notThis.when: zones and what runs in them are the point
logical parts and their links are the point

types.basis: not planned: illustration with no data to compute it from

closest.caveat: Axonometric plan is not planned; Treemap (Treemap) is the closest available type.

types.name: Venn
types.bestFor: Overlaps between two or three sets, with a count or label per region.

notThis.when: there are more than three sets
set sizes matter more than their overlap

closest.caveat: Venn is not built yet (new); Bar (BarList) is the closest available type.

types.name: Pyramid / funnel
types.bestFor: Stages that narrow by value, or a ranked hierarchy drawn widest at the base.

notThis.when: the stages do not narrow
flows split and merge between stages

closest.caveat: Pyramid / funnel is not built yet (new); Bar (BarList) is the closest available type.

types.name: Bar
types.bestFor: Comparing one value across categories.

notThis.when: the categories are points in time and the trend matters
a running total steps up and down
the values are nested parts of one whole

types.basis: ui/charts/bar-list and spark-bars; columns are variant V1

types.name: Waterfall
types.bestFor: How a starting total becomes a final one through gains and losses.

notThis.when: each value stands on its own

closest.caveat: Waterfall is not built yet (new); Bar (BarList) is the closest available type.

types.name: Treemap
types.bestFor: Shares of a whole across many parts, nested when the parts group.

notThis.when: there are only a few parts
the hierarchy itself matters more than size

types.name: Heatmap
types.bestFor: A grid of two categories with an intensity in each cell.

notThis.when: each cell holds a category, not a level

types.budget: Up to 12 by 12 cells and 4 intensity steps.

closest.caveat: Heatmap is not built yet (in-flight); Treemap (Treemap) is the closest available type.

types.name: Line
types.bestFor: A measure changing over time, including slope, bump and ridgeline forms.

notThis.when: the data are discrete events, not a measure
the categories have no order

types.basis: ui/charts/line-chart, built but not exported yet (TD-34); slope and bump are V2, ridgeline V5

closest.caveat: Line is not built yet (in-flight); Scatter (Scatter) is the closest available type.

types.name: Gantt
types.bestFor: Tasks with start and end dates on one time axis, plus milestones.

notThis.when: events are single moments
cards move through workflow columns

closest.caveat: Gantt is not built yet (new); Timeline (Timeline) is the closest available type.

types.name: Scatter
types.bestFor: How two measures relate across many items, with bubble size as an optional third.

notThis.when: the axes are judgements and the corners carry meaning
one measure is tracked over time

types.budget: Points readable without overlap; label at most 8.

types.name: High-level overview
types.bestFor: A one-glance overview of a data stack, with phases across the top.

notThis.when: routes and boundaries need detail

types.basis: architecture map preset plus a phase chevron band

closest.caveat: High-level overview is not built yet (template); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Process
types.bestFor: Ordered stages that each answer the same questions, with inputs and outputs.

notThis.when: the rows are owners, not questions
branching decisions matter

types.budget: 3 to 6 stages and up to 4 slot rows.

closest.caveat: Process is not built yet (template); Timeline (Timeline) is the closest available type.

types.name: Tiers (medallion)
types.bestFor: Data quality tiers from raw to curated, with who may read each.

notThis.when: the layers are general, not data quality tiers

closest.caveat: Tiers (medallion) is not built yet (template); Bar (BarList) is the closest available type.

types.name: Data flow
types.bestFor: Where data comes from, what transforms it and where it ends up.

notThis.when: the order of decisions is the point
volumes split and merge along the way

types.basis: NetworkGraph clustered layout, grouped by role

closest.caveat: Data flow is not built yet (ng); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Hub and spoke
types.bestFor: One central system and those around it, labelled with how each connects.

notThis.when: the outer systems also connect to each other

closest.caveat: Hub and spoke is not built yet (ng); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Access matrix
types.bestFor: Which roles may do what, with one categorical value per cell.

notThis.when: the cells hold a level, not a category
controls are grouped by where they are enforced

types.basis: matrix preset on the heatmap (after TD-35)

closest.caveat: Access matrix is not built yet (template); Bar (BarList) is the closest available type.

types.name: Sankey
types.bestFor: Quantities moving from sources to destinations, with band width set by volume.

notThis.when: the stages only narrow, without splitting
the paths matter, not the amounts

closest.caveat: Sankey is not built yet (new); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Fishbone
types.bestFor: Causes of one effect, grouped into categories along a spine.

notThis.when: the causes form a general hierarchy

closest.caveat: Fishbone is not built yet (new); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Wardley map
types.bestFor: Components placed by how visible they are to users and how mature they are.

notThis.when: the axes are opinions with no maturity scale

types.basis: NetworkGraph supplied layout plus an axis frame

closest.caveat: Wardley map is not built yet (ng); Scatter (Scatter) is the closest available type.

types.name: Kanban
types.bestFor: Work items shown as cards in workflow columns.

notThis.when: dates and durations matter

closest.caveat: Kanban is not built yet (in-flight); Bar (BarList) is the closest available type.

types.name: User journey
types.bestFor: A customer's steps through a service and how they feel at each one.

notThis.when: back-office work matters as much as the customer

types.basis: StageGrid plus a LineChart sentiment row

closest.caveat: User journey is not built yet (template); Timeline (Timeline) is the closest available type.

types.name: Service blueprint
types.bestFor: A service seen from the customer down through staff and back-office systems.

notThis.when: only the customer view matters

types.budget: 4 or 5 lanes and up to 7 steps.

closest.caveat: Service blueprint is not built yet (template); Timeline (Timeline) is the closest available type.

types.name: Deployment
types.bestFor: What runs where: zones, hosts and replica counts.

notThis.when: logical parts matter, not where they run

closest.caveat: Deployment is not built yet (ng); Dependency graph (NetworkGraph) is the closest available type.

types.name: Dependency graph
types.bestFor: Things that depend on other things, including shared and circular dependencies.

notThis.when: every node has exactly one parent
boundaries and zones matter

types.name: UML class
types.bestFor: Classes with their fields, operations and inheritance.

notThis.when: the model is stored data, not behaviour

types.basis: SchemaCard preset with an operations section

closest.caveat: UML class is not built yet (template); Entity relationship (SchemaCard) is the closest available type.

types.name: Story map
types.bestFor: User activities across the top, stories beneath by priority, and release cuts.

notThis.when: work moves through status columns

closest.caveat: Story map is not built yet (template); Treemap (Treemap) is the closest available type.

types.name: Database schema
types.bestFor: Tables, columns, keys and the foreign keys between them.

notThis.when: the model is conceptual, without column types
